name: Sakura Saki no Ha
source:
Mizuho was just an ordinary high school girl, but somehow she ended up in another world...
It seems she can't return until she defeats that man...
So she ends up teaming up with the guy she meets on the roadside.

What will happen to Mizuho?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13033]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
瑞穗原本只是一个普通的女高中生，却不知为何来到了异世界……
看来，不打败那个男人，她就回不来了……
所以她最终和她在路边遇到的那个人组队。

瑞穗会发生什么事呢？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13033]Novelgame[/url]]
